contentList.content: Create a vine surface, slowing down creatures, possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ENSNARED_VINES">Entangling</LSTag> them.

When you are about to be hit by an enemy, increase your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> by 5. You take no damage from <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_MagicMissile">Magic Missile</LSTag>.
Doesn't affect creatures that don't rely on sight or that can see through illusions.
Shape a piece of ground into hard spikes. Movement is halved. A creature walking on the spikes takes [1] for every [2] it moves.
Make a creature larger or smaller to affect their weapon damage and Strength <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Make a creature smaller. Its weapons deal [1] less damage. It has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Bestow the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Fly">Fly</LSTag> upon yourself or an ally.

Target up to 6 creatures and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SLOW">Slow</LSTag> them. Movement and actions are affected, and their <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">AC</LSTag> and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saves</LSTag> are reduced by 2.
Immediately gain an extra <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> to use this turn.
Enclose a target in a sphere of shimmering force, blocking all incoming damage and spell effects.
The sphere reduces the target's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> by half, and also prevents it from casting spells or dealing damage.
